Pasha Adoption and Rehabilitation Center is a non-profit animal rescue established in February 2022. Our Center was founded by members of Vucjak Shelter’s Adoption Team as a pilot project to facilitate the rehabilitation and adoption of special-need animals and provide palliative care for the critically ill ones that would otherwise struggle in a shelter environment.

We offer a spay/neuter program, comprehensive vet care, and adoption services in Serbia and abroad. Thanks to our staff’s skilled handling and training, all our adoptable animals are well socialized and friendly with other dogs, cats, and humans!

As a foster-based rescue, we focus on placing our animals in secure, caring foster homes once they are rehabilitated and ready for adoption. We are dedicated to building a coalition of rescue-minded individuals and organizations across Europe, the U.K., Canada, and the United States so that together, we can save more at-risk stray animals in Serbia.

https://www.PashaARC.co.uk
